description: This Java source file defines the CCPaymentServices class, which provides various static methods to handle payment transactions such as authorization, capture, refund, release, reauthorization, and report generation within the ClearCommerce payment gateway integration. It also contains utility methods for building XML request documents, parsing XML responses, and sending HTTP requests to the payment server.

classes.name: ClearCommerceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to ClearCommerce interactions.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs a pre-authorization or authorization transaction with the ClearCommerce payment gateway based on provided context, building appropriate XML requests and processing XML responses.

methods.name: ccCredit
methods.description: Performs a credit (refund) transaction, constructing XML request, sending it, and processing the response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures an authorized payment, building and sending the request, then parsing the response.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases (voids) a previously authorized transaction, processing the XML response accordingly.

methods.name: ccReleaseNoop
methods.description: Returns success with existing authorization data without attempting a real release.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Performs a refund transaction, handling request creation, sending, and response parsing.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Re-authorizes an existing transaction, building the request and processing the response.

methods.name: ccReport
methods.description: Generates a report from ClearCommerce using XML requests, mainly by building and sending report requests, handling responses.

methods.name: buildPrimaryTxRequest
methods.description: Constructs an XML document for primary transactions such as authorization, credit, etc., including payment and address details.

methods.name: buildSecondaryTxRequest
methods.description: Builds XML for secondary transactions like capture, release, refund, based on transaction IDs.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Serializes XML request, sends it via HTTP POST to the ClearCommerce server, and parses the XML response.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Extracts message list from the response XML, including severity and message text.

methods.name: getMessageListMaxSev
methods.description: Determines the maximum severity level among messages in the response XML.

methods.name: getReferenceNum
methods.description: Extracts the reference number (transaction ID) from response XML.
